card.name: End of Immune-Mediated section headings
card.fires_on: The last piece of a capitalized section heading, mostly "iated" in "Immune-Mediated" right before a condition name such as Colitis or Pneumonitis. It also fires on a heading word like "Grade" or "of" when a title-case term should follow.

modes.label: Immune-Mediated headings
modes.description: Ending of the heading "Immune-Mediated" in checkpoint-inhibitor labels, before a condition name.

modes.label: Other title-case headings
modes.description: A word inside a numbered section heading where another capitalized heading word follows.
modes.example: 2.4 Recommended Dosage for Reversal<< of>> Neuromuscular Blockade in Adults

card.writes: It pushes the next word to be a capitalized title-case word starting a new term, and away from common nouns like Table or Store.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a section title where the next capitalized word, usually a condition name, is about to come.
